title: Most "cinnamon" isn't real cinnamon. Here's why
post_text:
Most cinnamon sold worldwide is cassia 🌿 True cinnamon is the paper-thin inner bark of one tree, peeled by hand in Sri Lanka.
#ceyloncinnamon #srilanka #truecinnamon #cassia #learnontiktok #explained
